products.name: ReWalk Personal Exoskeleton
products.description: A battery-powered, wearable robotic exoskeleton designed for individuals with spinal cord injury (paraplegia) to enable standing, walking, and climbing stairs/curbs in home, community, and work settings. Each unit is custom-fitted and configured for the user, manufactured in-house, and distributed globally via direct sales and distributors.

products.name: ReWalk Rehabilitation Exoskeleton
products.description: A clinic-based version of the ReWalk exoskeleton, equipped with multiple adjustable parts to fit different users for exercise, training, and therapy in rehabilitation centers. Enables clinics to train multiple patients and evaluate their capacity for personal exoskeleton use.

products.name: AlterG Anti-Gravity Systems
products.description: A line of rehabilitation treadmills using patented Differential Air Pressure (DAP) technology to reduce effective body weight for patients during physical and neurological rehabilitation. Manufactured by contract partners, these systems are sold to clinics, hospitals, and sports teams, and include models such as NEO, NEO+, and PRO, with optional Stride Smart gait analytics software.

products.name: ReStore Exo-Suit
products.description: A lightweight, fabric-based soft exosuit designed for use in rehabilitation clinics to assist walking in stroke patients with lower limb disabilities. The device provides targeted mechanical assistance to the ankle and is sold to clinics for use during therapy sessions.

products.name: MYOLYN MyoCycle Functional Electrical Stimulation (FES) Cycles
products.description: Stationary cycling devices that use functional electrical stimulation to activate muscles in individuals with neurological impairments. Distributed to U.S. rehabilitation clinics (MyoCycle Pro) and to veterans for home use (MyoCycle Home) through the Veterans Health Administration.

products.name: AlterG Consumables and Service Contracts
products.description: Proprietary consumables (such as shorts for air chamber seal) and extended service contracts for installation, maintenance, and repair of AlterG Anti-Gravity systems. Provides recurring revenue from the installed base of devices in clinics and sports facilities.

products.name: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
products.description: Fully integrated battery-based energy storage systems (B-VAULT), including AC and DC-coupled configurations, designed for short-duration storage (1-4 hours) and scalable for utility, commercial, and industrial applications. These systems are physically manufactured using batteries, inverters, and modular enclosures, and delivered as turnkey equipment or projects.

products.name: Gravity Energy Storage Systems (GESS)
products.description: Proprietary gravity-based energy storage systems (G-VAULT) that use mechanical lifting and lowering of composite blocks or water to store and dispatch energy, designed for long-duration storage and infrastructure applications. These are large-scale, physically constructed assets, commercialized via licensing and project delivery.

products.name: Hydrogen and Hybrid Energy Storage Systems
products.description: Hydrogen or hybrid energy storage systems (H-VAULT) that integrate hydrogen fuel cells with battery storage to provide multi-day or customer-specific resiliency and duration requirements. These systems are engineered and physically integrated for site-specific deployments, often for grid resiliency.

products.name: Energy Management and Optimization Software
products.description: Proprietary, technology-agnostic software solutions (VaultOS EMS, Vault-Bidder, Vault-Manager) for real-time monitoring, control, dispatch, and optimization of energy storage and generation assets. Delivered as licensed or subscription-based digital products, these platforms support asset management, market participation, and performance analytics.

products.name: Long-Term Operations and Maintenance Services
products.description: Lifecycle services for energy storage systems, including maintenance, monitoring, performance management, and operational support, delivered through long-term service agreements. These services involve in-person human labor and digital monitoring to ensure asset availability and performance.

products.name: Development, Ownership, and Operation of Energy Storage Assets
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of energy storage projects (via Asset Vault platform), generating recurring revenue through contracted offtake, market participation, or tolling agreements. This involves capital investment, project development, and ongoing asset management, often under long-term contracts.

products.name: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (Powered Shells)
products.description: Development, construction, and operation of modular, powered data center infrastructure designed for high-density compute workloads, including AI applications. These are physically built, scalable facilities delivered under long-term contracts or power purchase agreements to data center operators and compute customers.

products.name: Licensing and Royalties of Energy Storage Technologies
products.description: Licensing of proprietary energy storage technologies (e.g., B-VAULT, G-VAULT) and related know-how to third parties, generating revenue through intellectual property licenses and royalties. This is a contractual, non-physical product line.

products.name: Foodservice Distribution for Asian Restaurants
products.description: Distribution of a broad assortment of food and non-food products, with a strong focus on specialty ingredients essential for Asian cuisine, to Asian restaurants and other foodservice customers across the United States. This is enabled by a national network of distribution centers, cross-docks, and a temperature-controlled fleet, providing high-frequency, reliable delivery and consolidated purchasing.

products.name: Seafood Products
products.description: Procurement and distribution of a wide range of seafood, including lobster, shrimp, crab, scallops, and various fish, both fresh and frozen, sourced domestically and internationally. These products are delivered through the company's logistics network to foodservice customers.

products.name: Meat and Poultry Products
products.description: Distribution of beef, pork, chicken, and duck products, sourced primarily from domestic suppliers, to restaurant and foodservice customers. Products are delivered via temperature-controlled logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Asian Specialty Food Products
products.description: Sourcing and distribution of specialty Asian food products, including noodles, rice, dry goods, sauces, seasonings, spring rolls, and canned products, many of which are not widely available from mainstream distributors. These are sourced both domestically and through imports.

products.name: General Commodities for Foodservice
products.description: Distribution of general food commodities such as oil, flour, salt, and sugar, which are essential for restaurant operations. These are sourced primarily from domestic suppliers and delivered through the company's logistics network.

products.name: Fresh Produce
products.description: Distribution of fresh, seasonal fruits and vegetables widely used in Asian cuisines, sourced from domestic growers and delivered to foodservice customers via temperature-controlled logistics.

products.name: Packaging and Non-Food Restaurant Supplies
products.description: Distribution of packaging and non-food products such as take-out accessories, bamboo chopsticks, takeout containers, plastic cups, and sushi combo boxes, supporting restaurant operations. These are sourced from both domestic and international suppliers.

products.name: Data Center Leasing
products.description: Leasing of secure, highly connected, and continuously available data center space, ranging from single cabinets to multi-megawatt deployments, delivered through physically constructed and managed facilities with power, cooling, and security infrastructure.

products.name: Colocation Services
products.description: Provision of shared data center space (from single cabinets to suites) for customers to deploy their IT infrastructure, with managed power, cooling, and security, allowing customers to avoid building their own data centers.

products.name: Interconnection Services
products.description: Offering physical and virtual connectivity solutions within and between data centers, including cross connects, metro connects, and global network orchestration, enabling customers to exchange data securely and efficiently across networks and cloud providers.

products.name: Cloud Enablement Services
products.description: Providing infrastructure and connectivity solutions that facilitate hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, including direct cloud on-ramps and integration with major cloud service providers, delivered via physical and virtual connections in data centers.

products.name: Powered Base Building® Leasing
products.description: Leasing of powered shell data center buildings that provide the physical location, power, and network access for customers to build and operate their own data center infrastructure, requiring significant real estate and utility infrastructure.

products.name: Critical Facilities Management® Services
products.description: Provision of 24/7 operational support, engineering, and maintenance services for mission-critical data center facilities, delivered by specialized teams to ensure uptime and operational efficiency.

products.name: Flavored Malt Beverages
products.description: Alcoholic beverages produced using malt fermentation and proprietary flavorings, primarily manufactured at company-owned breweries and contract facilities, and sold under brands such as Twisted Tea and Hard Mountain Dew. Distributed in cans and bottles through retail and on-premise channels.

products.name: Hard Seltzer
products.description: Alcoholic seltzer beverages produced using fermentation and flavorings, available in a variety of styles and flavors under the Truly Hard Seltzer brand. Manufactured at company and contract facilities, primarily packaged in sleek cans for national distribution.

products.name: Craft Beer
products.description: A range of traditional and innovative beers, including lagers, IPAs, and seasonal varieties, produced at company-owned breweries and taprooms under the Samuel Adams and Dogfish Head brands. Distributed nationally in bottles, cans, and kegs, with some specialty releases available at local taprooms.

products.name: Hard Cider
products.description: Alcoholic cider beverages produced from apples, including proprietary and specialty varieties, manufactured at the company-owned cidery and orchard under the Angry Orchard brand. Distributed nationally in bottles, cans, and kegs, with specialty ciders available at the cidery.

products.name: Spirits-Based Ready-to-Drink Beverages (Spirits RTDs)
products.description: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverages using distilled spirits (such as vodka), produced and packaged in cans under brands like Sun Cruiser, Dogfish Head, and Sinless Vodka Cocktails. Manufactured at company and contract facilities and distributed nationally.

products.name: Distilled Spirits
products.description: Small-batch distilled spirits, including vodka and other liquors, produced at company-owned distilleries under the Dogfish Head and Sinless Spirits brands. Sold in limited markets and quantities, primarily through specialty retail and on-site locations.

products.name: Non-Alcoholic Beer
products.description: Non-alcoholic beers produced using traditional brewing methods with alcohol removal, available under the Samuel Adams brand. Distributed nationally in bottles and cans, with specialty releases at taprooms.

products.name: Cannabis Beverages and Edibles (Canada only)
products.description: Cannabis-infused beverages and gummies produced and sold in Canada under the TeaPot and Emerald Hour brands, leveraging a dedicated research and innovation hub. Not sold in the United States.

products.name: On-Site Taproom and Restaurant Retail
products.description: Direct-to-consumer sales of company-produced beers, ciders, and spirits at company-owned taprooms, restaurants, and gift shops, including specialty and limited-edition products. Includes locations such as Samuel Adams Boston Downtown Tap Room, Dogfish Head Brewings and Eats, and Chesapeake & Maine.

products.name: Tebipenem HBr (tebipenem pivoxil hydrobromide)
products.description: An orally administered carbapenem-class antibiotic developed for the treatment of complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI), including pyelonephritis, in adults. Tebipenem HBr is produced through pharmaceutical manufacturing and, if approved, will be delivered as an oral tablet, offering an alternative to IV-administered carbapenems.

products.name: Automotive Refinish Coatings
products.description: High-performance liquid and powder coatings systems, including color matching technologies, fillers, aerosols, and adhesives, used by body shops to repair and restore vehicle appearance. Products are manufactured in-house and delivered through distributors or direct sales, with technical support and digital tools for productivity.

products.name: Industrial Coatings
products.description: Liquid, e-coat, and powder coatings for a wide range of industrial applications, including building products, construction, energy and battery solutions, transportation components, and general metal finishing. Products are manufactured and delivered globally, with technical service and regional support.

products.name: Light Vehicle OEM Coatings
products.description: Comprehensive coatings systems for light vehicle original equipment manufacturers, including electrocoat, primer, basecoat, and clearcoat layers. Products are manufactured to precise specifications and delivered directly to OEM assembly plants, with on-site technical support and process optimization services.

products.name: Commercial Vehicle OEM Coatings
products.description: Coatings systems for commercial vehicle manufacturers, including trucks, buses, rail, motorcycles, marine, and specialty vehicles. Products include custom color solutions and advanced technologies for durability and appearance, delivered directly to OEMs with technical support.

products.name: Coatings Application Equipment and Digital Solutions
products.description: Proprietary color matching and mixing equipment (e.g., Axalta Irus Scan™, Axalta Irus Mix™) and digital platforms (e.g., Axalta Nimbus™) that support customers in color retrieval, product ordering, inventory management, and process optimization. These are sold as part of the coatings solution to enhance productivity and accuracy.

products.name: Technical Services and Consulting for Coatings Application
products.description: Expert services and consulting for productivity improvement, application design, process optimization, and troubleshooting, provided to OEM and refinish customers alongside coatings products. Delivered through on-site representatives and digital tools.

products.name: Aerial Fire Suppression Services
products.description: Deployment of specialized amphibious aircraft (Super Scoopers and Spanish Scoopers) to drop large volumes of water directly onto active wildfires, supporting ground crews and enabling rapid, repeated water delivery. This service requires physical aircraft operations, highly trained pilots, and is delivered under contract to governmental and commercial customers.

products.name: Aerial Surveillance and Intelligence Services
products.description: Provision of aerial surveillance using manned aircraft equipped with advanced sensors and communications systems for wildfire detection, perimeter mapping, real-time video downlink, and command and control. Includes delivery of real-time data and intelligence to incident commanders via integrated software platforms. Delivered through physical aircraft and digital platforms to government and commercial clients.

products.name: Aerospace Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) Services
products.description: Maintenance and repair services for return-to-service upgrades of firefighting aircraft, as well as turnkey aerospace engineering, airframe modification, and integration solutions for manned and unmanned, rotary- and fixed-wing platforms. Delivered through in-person technical labor and engineering for both internal and external (governmental and commercial) customers.

products.name: Oncology Diagnostic Testing Services
products.description: Comprehensive cancer-focused laboratory testing services including cytogenetics, FISH, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, morphologic analysis, and molecular testing, performed in CAP/CLIA/ISO-accredited labs and delivered to healthcare providers for patient diagnosis and management.

products.name: Molecular and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) Testing
products.description: Advanced molecular and NGS-based assays for cancer, including single-gene tests, targeted panels (NeoTYPE, PanTracer, Neo Comprehensive), and whole exome sequencing, utilizing DNA/RNA analysis and delivered as laboratory services to clinicians and pharmaceutical clients.

products.name: Molecular Residual Disease (MRD) Testing
products.description: Highly sensitive molecular and flow-based assays, including liquid biopsy (RaDaR®), to detect minimal residual disease and recurrence in cancer patients, leveraging NGS and flow cytometry technologies, provided to clinicians and pharmaceutical companies.

products.name: Interpretation and Consultative Services
products.description: Professional interpretation of laboratory test results and consultative pathology services by specialized physicians and molecular experts, including primary diagnosis, secondary consultations, and overflow interpretation, delivered to healthcare providers.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Clinical Trials and Research Support Services
products.description: Laboratory testing, biomarker analysis, assay development, sample analysis, and data reporting services provided to pharmaceutical companies in support of sponsor-led research studies and clinical trials, performed under regulatory and quality standards.

products.name: Oncology Data Solutions
products.description: Licensing of de-identified oncology data and real-world evidence to pharmaceutical and biotech customers, including retrospective and prospective data deliveries, supporting clinical trial recruitment and clinical decision support.

products.name: Validation Laboratory Services
products.description: Specialized laboratory services for validating assays and laboratory-developed tests, supporting external clients such as pharmaceutical companies and research organizations, performed in accredited laboratory settings.

products.name: Photomasks for Integrated Circuits (ICs)
products.description: High precision quartz or glass plates containing microscopic images of electronic circuits, manufactured using electron beam or optical lithography systems, and used as masters to transfer circuit patterns onto semiconductor wafers during IC fabrication. Production involves data conversion, lithography, etching, inspection, and defect repair in controlled clean rooms.

products.name: Photomasks for Flat Panel Displays (FPDs)
products.description: High precision quartz or glass plates with microscopic images of electronic circuits, produced using optical lithography systems, and used as masters to transfer circuit patterns onto FPD substrates for display manufacturing. The process includes data conversion, lithography, etching, inspection, and defect repair in clean rooms.

products.name: Generative AI Solutions for Defense and Intelligence
products.description: Platform-agnostic generative AI software, including FedRAMP-authorized solutions, designed for secure use by defense and intelligence agencies. Delivered as cloud-based and on-premises platforms, requiring compliance with federal security standards and integration with sensitive government systems.

products.name: Edge AI and Autonomy Platforms for Defense
products.description: AI, data, and sensor orchestration platforms (e.g., ConductorOS) enabling real-time analytics, computer vision, and autonomous operations at the tactical edge for military and defense applications. Delivered as integrated software and hardware solutions for distributed and disconnected environments.

products.name: Operational Readiness and Decision Support Solutions
products.description: Software and expert services that streamline and optimize military and government operational planning, forecasting, and risk management by integrating data analytics and subject matter expertise. Delivered as decision support platforms and consulting for process performance and event prediction.

products.name: Digital Identity and Biometric Verification Solutions
products.description: AI-powered software for digital identity verification and biometrics, leveraging advanced vision technologies and machine learning to authenticate individuals in security-sensitive and commercial environments. Delivered as software platforms for secure and efficient identity management.

products.name: Digital Twin Modeling and Simulation Tools
products.description: Modeling and simulation software that creates digital twins of complex operational systems, enabling rapid scenario analysis and optimization for manufacturing, logistics, and business processes. Delivered as software tools for capital investment, design, and operational planning.

products.name: Logistics and Supply Chain Management AI Solutions
products.description: AI-driven software platforms (e.g., CargoSeer) for logistics, supply chain management, and cargo inspection, combining computer vision, automated image analysis, and trade data to enhance security and efficiency at ports and border crossings. Delivered as specialized software for customs and trade risk management.

products.name: Consumer Products
products.description: Manufactured and packaged finished consumer products, primarily sunscreen lotions and cosmetic products, delivered through large-scale production and assembly facilities registered with the FDA for OTC drug manufacturing.

products.name: Personal Care Ingredients
products.description: Manufactured personal care ingredients, including advanced materials such as coated particles and dispersions, supplied to external customers (e.g., BASF) for use in personal care formulations; production involves particle coating, dispersion, and compliance with cGMP and ISO standards.

products.name: Digital Transformation and Technology Advisory Services
products.description: Comprehensive advisory services helping organizations optimize performance, reduce costs, and accelerate innovation through digital transformation. Delivered by experienced consultants leveraging proprietary data, analytics, and global delivery models.

products.name: AI Advisory Services
products.description: Consulting services guiding clients through AI adoption, including readiness assessments, strategic roadmaps, procurement guidance, and implementation oversight. Delivered via expert advisory and proprietary frameworks, with a focus on responsible AI and measurable outcomes.

products.name: ISG Research and Market Intelligence
products.description: Subscription-based research and market intelligence services providing benchmarking, provider evaluations, pricing insights, and industry analyses. Delivered through proprietary datasets, analyst coverage, and digital platforms.

products.name: Platform-Enabled Supplier and Contract Management (ISG GovernX)
products.description: Cloud-based platform offering supplier and contract management, risk mitigation, performance benchmarking, and automation of third-party relationship management. Integrates with enterprise applications and leverages AI for automation and analytics.

products.name: Sourcing and Procurement Advisory (including ISG Tango)
products.description: Advisory and platform-enabled services supporting sourcing strategy, provider selection, contract negotiation, and operational benchmarking. Delivered via the ISG Tango platform and expert consultants, influencing billions in contract value annually.

products.name: Benchmarking and Performance Analytics (ISG Inform)
products.description: Data-as-a-service platform providing benchmarking of digital transformation, IT, and application development maturity against industry peers. Delivered via dashboards and analytics using proprietary cost and sourcing databases.

products.name: Organizational Change Management (OCM) Services
products.description: Consulting services supporting organizational alignment, stakeholder management, communications, and training to drive adoption of technology and business transformation. Delivered through structured change plans, analytics, and digital OCM platforms.

products.name: Training-as-a-Service (TaaS) and Managed Learning Services
products.description: Outsourced training and learning services, including custom content development, digital learning platforms, and ongoing workforce training. Delivered using agile methods, digital adoption platforms, and managed service models.

products.name: Software Advisory Services
products.description: Consulting services for optimizing software supplier relationships, architecture validation, provider selection, contract negotiation, deployment, and software asset management. Delivered through expert advisory, analytics, and buyer guides.

products.name: Network Solutions Advisory (ISG Network)
products.description: Advisory services for enterprise network transformation, including SD-WAN, SD-LAN, security, 5G, and unified communications. Delivered via vendor data, solution selection support, and pricing negotiation insights.

products.name: Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance
products.description: Comprehensive insurance products for businesses of all sizes, including workers' compensation, general liability, commercial property, commercial automobile, marine, professional liability, bond (fidelity and surety), and package policies. These are underwritten and delivered through a mix of retail and wholesale agents, brokers, and direct channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and specialized underwriting expertise.

products.name: Personal Automobile and Homeowners Insurance
products.description: Insurance products for individuals, primarily covering personal automobiles and residences (including homeowners, renters, and related coverages). Delivered through direct-to-consumer and independent agent channels, with a significant focus on the mature market via the AARP Program. Requires regulated infrastructure and digital service capabilities.

products.name: Employee Group Benefits Insurance and Services
products.description: Group insurance products and services for employer groups, associations, and affinity groups, including group life, short-term and long-term disability, paid family leave, and other supplemental health coverages. Also includes leave management and claims administration services, delivered through brokers, consultants, and private exchanges. Requires regulated insurance operations and digital administration platforms.

products.name: Mutual Funds and Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)
products.description: A broad range of actively managed mutual funds and ETFs across various asset classes, including equity, fixed income, and multi-strategy investments. Products are distributed through broker-dealers, financial advisers, and retirement plans, and require financial capital, regulatory compliance, and investment management expertise.

products.name: Assumed Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance services for property, liability, surety, credit and political, marine, and agriculture risks, primarily in Europe and the Americas. Delivered through treaty and facultative arrangements, leveraging underwriting and risk management expertise in regulated international markets.

products.name: Third-Party Investment Management Services
products.description: Investment management services for institutional clients and third-party accounts, including management of life and annuity separate accounts and pension assets. Delivered through a registered investment advisor subsidiary, requiring financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Online Casino Gaming (iCasino)
products.description: A digital platform offering over 6,000 casino games, including video slots, blackjack, roulette, baccarat, craps, video poker, and live dealer games, sourced from more than 90 third-party providers and delivered to customers globally via web-based interfaces. The service is operated under various brands and requires regulated remote gambling licenses.

products.name: Live Dealer Casino Games
products.description: A subset of online casino gaming where customers can play games such as blackjack, roulette, baccarat, craps, and game shows with live human dealers streamed online, enhancing interactivity and realism. Delivered digitally via the company's platform.

products.name: Online Casino Ratings and Reviews Portal
products.description: A web-based portal providing ratings, reviews, and lead generation for online casinos, targeting players in markets not directly served by the company's gaming brands. This service generates high-value leads and targeted search engine traffic for both the company's brands and third-party casinos.

products.name: Power Solutions and Protection
products.description: Includes internal and external AC/DC power supplies, DC/DC converters, DC/AC inverters, and circuit protection devices. These products are physically manufactured and delivered for use in powering and protecting electronic circuits across industries such as aerospace, defense, networking, transportation, industrial, and medical.

products.name: Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive line of copper and optical fiber connectors, cable assemblies, RF connectors, and related devices for high-speed and harsh environment connectivity. These are physically manufactured components and assemblies used in commercial aerospace, military, defense, network infrastructure, and industrial applications.

products.name: Magnetic Solutions
products.description: Includes integrated connector modules (ICMs), power transformers, power inductors, and discrete magnetic components. These are manufactured components used for conditioning, filtering, and isolating electronic signals, as well as providing power distribution and energy storage in electronic devices.

products.name: Nut Products
products.description: Raw and processed nuts, including peanuts, pecans, cashews, walnuts, almonds, and other varieties, are processed, packaged, and distributed in various styles, seasonings, and package sizes. Production involves vertical integration from procurement, shelling, processing, to packaging and marketing.

products.name: Snack and Nutrition Bars
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of a complete portfolio of snack and nutrition bars, including chewy granola, fruit and grain, sweet and salty, dipped chewy granola, crunchy, energy, fiber, and nut bars. Production is primarily in-house and delivered under both private and company brands.

products.name: Snack and Trail Mixes
products.description: Production and distribution of snack and trail mixes, often combining nuts, dried fruits, seeds, and other ingredients, sold under company and private brands. These are manufactured and packaged in various formats for retail and ingredient customers.

products.name: Nut Butters
products.description: Manufacture and marketing of peanut butter, almond butter, and cashew butter in several sizes and varieties, produced in-house and distributed to retailers and wholesalers.

products.name: Candy and Confections
products.description: Production and distribution of candy and confectionery products, including chocolate and yogurt coated items, often using nuts as a base ingredient, sold to retailers and wholesalers.

products.name: Dried Fruit and Salad Toppings
products.description: Processing and distribution of dried fruit and salad toppings, including sunflower kernels, pepitas, and other ingredients, sold to retailers, wholesalers, and commercial ingredient users.

products.name: Corn Snacks and Sesame Snack Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of corn snacks, sesame sticks, and other sesame-based snack products, distributed to retail supermarkets, mass merchandisers, and commercial ingredient users.

products.name: Baked Cheese Snack Products
products.description: Production and distribution of baked cheese snack products, such as those under the Just the Cheese brand, manufactured and packaged for retail and private label customers.

products.name: Commercial Ingredient Products
products.description: Customized nut-based and snack ingredient products processed and packaged to the specifications of food manufacturers, restaurant chains, and foodservice distributors for use in their final food products.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing Services
products.description: Processing and packaging of nut and fruit-based snacks for other food companies under their brand names and specifications, leveraging the company's manufacturing capabilities.

products.name: Fertility Benefits Solution
products.description: A comprehensive fertility benefits program for employers, centered on the proprietary Smart Cycle treatment bundles, which include diagnostic testing, access to advanced fertility technologies, and a selective network of fertility specialists. Delivered through employer contracts and managed via a digital platform with concierge support.

products.name: Integrated Pharmacy Benefits Solution (Progyny Rx)
products.description: An integrated pharmacy benefits management service that provides members with access to fertility medications, care management, formulary plan design, prescription fulfillment, and pharmacy support, delivered through a network of specialty pharmacies and digital tools.

products.name: Pregnancy and Postpartum Solution
products.description: A support program for pregnancy through postpartum and return-to-work, offering clinical guidance, coaching, emotional support, digital tools, and logistical expertise, delivered via an integrated care model.

products.name: Menopause and Midlife Solution
products.description: A program providing access to clinical coaching, digital tools, and a curated network of menopause and midlife providers, focused on early intervention and improved health outcomes, delivered through a specialized clinical network and digital support.

products.name: Benefit and Leave Navigation Solution
products.description: A concierge-level service for expecting parents, offering expert guidance, navigation and support for parental leave planning, including digital navigation tools, educational resources, and return-to-work support.

products.name: Parent and Child Wellbeing Solution
products.description: A support service for parents with children ages 0-12, providing personalized coaching, expert guidance, benefit navigation, stress-reduction strategies, and interactive education, delivered through licensed clinical social workers and digital resources.

products.name: Assistance Service Reimbursement Programs
products.description: Administration of employer-funded reimbursement programs for adoption, surrogacy, doula, and travel expenses related to medical services, including plan design and expense management.

products.name: Global Women’s Health and Family Building Solution (Progyny Global)
products.description: A global benefits solution offering expertise, partnership, and a compliant framework to deliver fertility, family building, and women’s health benefits internationally, including support, advocacy, and care navigation tailored to country-specific needs.

products.name: Retail Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail properties, including shopping centers and mixed-use developments anchored by grocery stores and big-box retailers, primarily in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern U.S. Properties are physically owned, managed, and leased to external tenants.

products.name: Office Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of Class A office space, primarily in mixed-use town centers and urban locations. Properties are physically owned, managed, and leased to external business tenants.

products.name: Multifamily Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of luxury apartment communities, primarily within mixed-use developments. Properties are physically owned, managed, and leased to residential tenants.

products.name: Real Estate Financing (Preferred Equity Investments)
products.description: Provision of preferred equity financing for third-party real estate development projects, typically multifamily, with terms similar to note receivables. These investments generate interest income and may provide a pipeline for future acquisitions.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for ATTR Amyloidosis
products.description: A portfolio of RNA interference (RNAi) therapeutics, including AMVUTTRA (vutrisiran), ONPATTRO (patisiran), and investigational nucresiran, for the treatment of hereditary and wild-type transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis (ATTR) with polyneuropathy and/or cardiomyopathy. These are manufactured using proprietary GalNAc-conjugate or LNP delivery platforms and administered via subcutaneous or intravenous injection.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Acute Hepatic Porphyria (AHP)
products.description: GIVLAARI (givosiran), a subcutaneously administered GalNAc-conjugate RNAi therapeutic, for the treatment of adults and adolescents with acute hepatic porphyria. Manufactured using proprietary RNAi technology and delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Primary Hyperoxaluria Type 1 (PH1)
products.description: OXLUMO (lumasiran), a subcutaneously administered GalNAc-conjugate RNAi therapeutic, for the treatment of primary hyperoxaluria type 1 in pediatric and adult patients. Manufactured using proprietary RNAi technology and delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Hypercholesterolemia
products.description: Leqvio (inclisiran), a subcutaneously administered RNAi therapeutic targeting PCSK9, developed and commercialized by Novartis under license, for the treatment of adults with hypercholesterolemia or mixed dyslipidemia. Manufactured using GalNAc-conjugate technology and delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Hemophilia
products.description: Qfitlia (fitusiran), a subcutaneously administered RNAi therapeutic targeting antithrombin, commercialized by Sanofi, for routine prophylaxis to prevent or reduce bleeding episodes in patients with hemophilia A or B, with or without inhibitors. Manufactured using proprietary RNAi technology and delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Hypertension
products.description: Zilebesiran, an investigational subcutaneously administered RNAi therapeutic targeting angiotensinogen, developed in collaboration with Roche, for the treatment of hypertension in high unmet need populations. Manufactured using GalNAc-conjugate technology and delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Complement-Mediated Diseases
products.description: Cemdisiran, a subcutaneously administered investigational RNAi therapeutic targeting the C5 component of the complement pathway, developed in collaboration with Regeneron, for the treatment of complement-mediated diseases such as myasthenia gravis and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria. Manufactured using proprietary RNAi technology and delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Chronic Hepatitis Delta Virus Infection
products.description: Elebsiran (formerly ALN-HBV02), a subcutaneously administered investigational RNAi therapeutic targeting the HBV genome, developed by Vir Biotechnology, for the treatment of chronic hepatitis delta. Manufactured using proprietary RNAi technology and delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy and Alzheimer’s Disease
products.description: Mivelsiran, an investigational, intrathecally administered RNAi therapeutic targeting amyloid precursor protein, for the treatment of cerebral amyloid angiopathy and Alzheimer’s disease. Utilizes C16 conjugate technology for enhanced CNS delivery.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Huntington’s Disease
products.description: ALN-HTT02, an investigational, intrathecally administered RNAi therapeutic targeting huntingtin, developed in collaboration with Regeneron, for the treatment of Huntington’s disease. Utilizes C16-siRNA delivery platform for CNS distribution.

products.name: RNAi Therapeutics for Bleeding Disorders
products.description: ALN-6400, a GalNAc-conjugated RNAi therapeutic targeting plasminogen, in early-stage clinical development for the treatment of hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia and other bleeding disorders. Delivered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: Research Intelligence SaaS Platforms
products.description: Cloud-based software platforms providing research-intensive organizations with tools for discovery, access, and management of scientific, technical, and medical (STM) content. Delivered as multi-tenant SaaS via annual or monthly subscriptions, these platforms integrate advanced AI, search, content acquisition, rights management, and workflow tools.

products.name: Single Article and Document Delivery Services
products.description: Transactional service providing electronic or physical delivery of individual STM journal articles, book chapters, and related content to researchers. Orders are fulfilled rapidly, often in seconds, with copyright compliance and permissions managed as part of the service.

products.name: Content Rights and Permissions Management
products.description: Service facilitating the acquisition of rights and permissions for re-use of STM content, ensuring copyright compliance for research, regulatory, marketing, and AI training use cases. Delivered through platform integrations and direct arrangements with publishers.

products.name: AI-Powered Research Workflow Tools
products.description: Advanced AI and generative AI assistants embedded in platform solutions to enhance literature search, citation analysis, content recommendations, and research workflow productivity. Delivered digitally as part of the SaaS offering.

products.name: Reference Management Solutions
products.description: Digital platform for organizing, managing, and collaborating on scholarly references and literature, with integrated document delivery and security features tailored for research organizations. Delivered as a SaaS solution.

products.name: Fiber Management and Protection Solutions
products.description: Modular panels, cabinets, wall boxes, enclosures, and cassettes designed and manufactured for managing, protecting, and routing fiber optic cables in broadband networks. These products are physically manufactured and assembled in company facilities and are used throughout inside plant, outside plant, and access network environments.

products.name: Fiber Pathway and Delivery Products
products.description: Factory-terminated, plug-and-play fiber assemblies, drop cables, microducts, and pathway systems that enable rapid and cost-effective deployment of fiber from network access points to homes, businesses, and cell sites. These are manufactured and assembled in company facilities and delivered as pre-connectorized solutions to customers.

products.name: Optical Components and Connectivity Hardware
products.description: Passive optical components such as splitters, couplers, multiplexers, demultiplexers, and attenuators integrated into fiber management platforms, built and tested for harsh environments to ensure reliable signal transmission. These are physically manufactured and tested to industry standards.

products.name: Outdoor Active Cabinets and Pedestals
products.description: Engineered outdoor cabinets and pedestals, including those with integrated active electronics or universal mounting options, designed to house fiber management solutions and support various network configurations. These are manufactured and assembled for deployment in outside plant environments.

products.name: Access Terminals and Drop Cable Solutions
products.description: Carrier-grade, plug-and-play access terminals and drop cable solutions that provide flexible, rapid connections from the network to end-user premises or cell sites. These products are manufactured and configured to support various mounting and splicing options.

products.name: Custom Fiber Assemblies and OEM Solutions
products.description: Custom-designed fiber assemblies and connectivity solutions manufactured to customer specifications, including both in-the-box and network connectivity assemblies for original equipment manufacturer (OEM) customers. These are produced in collaboration with customer engineering teams.

products.name: Fiber Connector Cleaning Products
products.description: Innovative dust caps and cleaning solutions for fiber connectors, designed to simplify installation and enhance network performance. These are manufactured products with built-in cleaning functionality for use during fiber network deployment and maintenance.

products.name: Telitacicept Autoimmune Therapeutics
products.description: A biologic fusion protein therapy developed and delivered via subcutaneous injection for the treatment of B cell-driven autoimmune diseases, including generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) and Sjögren’s disease (SjD). Manufactured using recombinant protein technology and distributed through specialty pharmaceutical channels, pending regulatory approval outside Greater China.

products.name: Electric Motorcycles
products.description: Electric motorcycles developed and sold under the LiveWire brand, utilizing proprietary modular architectures and in-house developed software, manufactured via contract manufacturing partners and distributed through independent dealers, a company-owned dealership, and online channels.

products.name: Electric Balance Bikes for Kids
products.description: Electric balance bikes for children ages 3 to 12, designed and developed under the STACYC brand, manufactured via contract manufacturing partners in Taiwan and China, and sold through independent dealers, distributors, and direct-to-consumer online channels.

products.name: Adult Pedal Assist Electric Bikes
products.description: Pedal-assist electric bicycles for adults, introduced under the STACYC segment, featuring rechargeable batteries and sold through dealers, distributors, and online direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Parts, Accessories, and Apparel
products.description: Replacement parts, mechanical and cosmetic accessories, and branded apparel and riding gear for both electric motorcycles and electric bikes, sold through the same distribution channels as the vehicles.

products.name: Automotive Steering Systems
products.description: Manufacture and sale of complete power steering systems, including hydraulic and electric power steering, for various segments of the automobile industry. These systems are produced in large-scale manufacturing facilities and delivered to OEMs and other customers globally.

products.name: Automotive Steering Components
products.description: Production and sale of key steering components such as rack and pinion gears, integral power steering gears, and steering columns, primarily for cars, light-duty, and heavy-duty vehicles. These are manufactured using physical production processes and supplied to automotive manufacturers.

products.name: Automotive Electronic Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of automotive electronic systems, including electronic control units and modules for steering and other vehicle functions. These are developed through R&D and produced in specialized facilities.

products.name: Automotive Motors and Electromechanical Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of automotive motors and electromechanical integrated systems, used in various automotive applications. Production involves both mechanical and electronic engineering.

products.name: Sensor Modules for Automobiles
products.description: Production and sale of sensor modules used in automotive applications, developed through R&D and manufactured in dedicated facilities.

products.name: High Polymer Materials for Automotive Use
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and sale of high polymer materials used in automotive parts and systems. These materials are produced in specialized manufacturing plants.

products.name: Inspection and Testing Services for Automotive Products
products.description: Provision of inspection and testing services for automotive products, utilizing specialized equipment and technical expertise. These services are offered to external customers for quality assurance and compliance.

products.name: Import and Sale of Automotive Parts (Brazil)
products.description: Import and sale of automotive parts in Brazil, involving trading and distribution activities rather than manufacturing. Products are sourced and sold to local customers.

products.name: Core Insurance Operations Platform (InsuranceSuite and InsuranceNow)
products.description: A cloud-based suite of applications providing policy administration, claims management, and billing for P&C insurers, delivered primarily as a subscription service and built on proprietary cloud infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Engagement Applications
products.description: Cloud-based applications enabling digital, omnichannel experiences for policyholders, agents, vendors, and field personnel, supporting self-service and automation across web and mobile devices.

products.name: Data and Analytics Solutions
products.description: A suite of cloud-native applications and platforms providing predictive analytics, business intelligence, risk modeling, and data management to help insurers make data-driven decisions and improve operational efficiency.

products.name: Guidewire Marketplace
products.description: An online marketplace offering vetted third-party and Guidewire-developed insurtech applications and integrations, enabling insurers to extend platform capabilities and accelerate innovation.

products.name: Implementation, Cloud Migration, and Integration Services
products.description: Professional services assisting customers with software implementation, cloud migration, and integration of Guidewire products with existing systems, delivered by internal teams and certified partners.

products.name: Customer Support and Cloud Assurance Services
products.description: Ongoing support and assurance services for subscription and license customers, including performance monitoring, configuration reviews, and regular software updates to ensure optimal operation and security.

products.name: Skilled Nursing Facility Services
products.description: Provision of sub-acute and post-acute skilled nursing care, intermediate nursing care, and related services in licensed facilities staffed by medical professionals, including 24-hour nursing, therapy, nutrition, and social services. Delivered in physical facilities requiring regulatory compliance and in-person care.

products.name: Rehabilitative Services
products.description: Physical, speech, respiratory, and occupational therapy services provided by licensed therapists, primarily to patients in NHC facilities but also to external healthcare providers. Delivered through in-person, regulated therapy staff.

products.name: Memory and Alzheimer’s Care
products.description: Specialized care and programs for persons with Alzheimer’s or related disorders, delivered in dedicated units within skilled nursing facilities by trained staff. Requires specialized facility units and regulated care protocols.

products.name: Assisted Living Services
products.description: Personal care and assistance with activities of daily living, such as dressing, bathing, meal preparation, and medication management, provided in assisted living facilities by qualified staff. Delivered in regulated residential settings.

products.name: Independent Living Services
products.description: Residential units for active elderly individuals, offering ancillary services such as dining, activities, and social areas. Delivered in purpose-built facilities, typically on a rental basis, with minimal medical oversight.

products.name: Behavioral Health Services
products.description: Inpatient and outpatient behavioral health care for adults and geriatric patients with psychiatric, emotional, and addictive disorders, provided in behavioral health hospitals and through intensive outpatient programs. Requires licensed hospital facilities and clinical staff.

products.name: Home Health Care Services
products.description: Medical and personal care services delivered at patients’ homes or assisted living residences, including skilled nursing, therapy, and assistance with daily activities. Provided by registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, and therapy professionals under regulated homecare agency structures.

products.name: Hospice Services
products.description: Hospice and palliative care for terminally ill patients, delivered in homes or facilities, including routine, inpatient, continuous, and respite care. Provided by specialized staff under Medicare-regulated programs.

products.name: Pharmacy Services
products.description: Operation of regional pharmacies supplying pharmaceutical products primarily to inpatients in NHC facilities, with electronic billing to Medicare Part D plans. Requires licensed pharmacy operations and regulated drug distribution.

products.name: Institutional Special Needs Plan (I-SNP) Insurance
products.description: Managed care insurance plan (NHC Advantage) for Medicare-eligible individuals needing skilled nursing facility-level care, providing care coordination and enhanced benefits. Delivered through a licensed insurance entity receiving per-member premiums from Medicare.

products.name: Management, Accounting, and Financial Services for Healthcare Facilities
products.description: Provision of management, accounting, and financial services to third-party operators of healthcare facilities, including skilled nursing, assisted living, and independent living centers. Delivered through service contracts and professional staff.

products.name: Insurance Services for Healthcare Facilities
products.description: Provision of workers’ compensation, general, and professional liability insurance coverage to owned, leased, and managed healthcare facilities, through licensed insurance subsidiaries. Delivered as regulated insurance products.

products.name: Healthcare Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of owned healthcare properties, including skilled nursing facilities and assisted living communities, to third-party operators. Delivered through property ownership and lease agreements.

products.name: Industrial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of industrial real estate properties, including warehouse/distribution, flex (light industrial and R&D), transshipment facilities, and improved land, to external customers. Properties are physically owned, managed, and maintained, and leases are provided to tenants for use in logistics, storage, manufacturing, and related activities.

products.name: Organizational Performance Improvement Solutions (Enterprise Division)
products.description: Comprehensive solutions for corporations, governments, and not-for-profits focused on leadership development, strategy execution, trust-building, and productivity. Delivered primarily through the All Access Pass (AAP) subscription, which provides digital access to proprietary content, assessments, implementation tools, and expert consulting/coaching. Solutions are deployed globally and can be customized for client needs.

products.name: Education Performance Improvement Solutions (Education Division)
products.description: Solutions for educational institutions centered on the Leader in Me membership, providing digital curriculum, leadership lessons, and implementation support. Delivered via online services and supported by experienced coaches and consultants, these offerings help schools improve student leadership, school culture, and academic proficiency.

products.name: Consulting and Advisory Services
products.description: Expert consulting and coaching services provided to both enterprise and education clients to support the implementation and alignment of FranklinCovey solutions. Delivered by professionals with deep expertise, these services are often bundled with subscriptions but can also be provided as standalone engagements.

products.name: Digital Learning Platforms and Tools
products.description: Digital platforms, including the All Access Pass and Leader in Me online service, that deliver FranklinCovey’s proprietary content, microcourses, assessments, and AI-powered coaching. These platforms enable scalable, on-demand learning and are accessible globally in multiple languages.

products.name: Printed and Digital Training Materials
products.description: Printed and digital materials, including books, manuals, workbooks, and other resources, used in training programs. These materials support both in-person and digital learning experiences and are available for purchase by clients as part of FranklinCovey’s offerings.

products.name: Value-Based Care Services for Medicare Advantage Members
products.description: P3 contracts with health plans to provide comprehensive, capitated care services for Medicare Advantage members, managing all health expenses and care coordination through a network of affiliated and employed primary care physicians. Services are delivered via a combination of local physician networks, P3-operated clinics, and wellness centers, leveraging both in-person care and proprietary technology platforms.

products.name: Population Health Management and Care Coordination
products.description: P3 delivers population health management services, including risk stratification, care management, and care navigation, to improve clinical outcomes and reduce costs for senior populations. These services are provided through dedicated care teams, personalized care plans, and collaboration with caregivers, supported by proprietary technology for data integration and analytics.

products.name: Delegated Managed Care Administrative Services
products.description: P3 assumes delegated responsibilities from payor partners, including provider network development, credentialing, utilization management, and claims processing. These services require regulatory compliance and enable P3 to manage the full care continuum and payment processes for health plan members.

products.name: Proprietary Healthcare Technology Platform (P3 Technology/Health Hub)
products.description: P3 offers a proprietary technology platform that integrates clinical and claims data, provides risk stratification, supports care management, and enables communication among physicians, care teams, and patients. The platform includes tools such as the Provider Portal, Care Connect, and Analytic Management Tools, which are used to enhance care delivery and operational efficiency.
